lines.text: A cold @soda_can sweats on a picnic table. A hand reaches in, cracks it open, and the fizz rises.
Macro; slow motion on the fizz.

new_beats.text: Some moments are best opened cold.

writes.note: I added a short VO line that lands as the can opens, and kept your action and direction as they were.

reply.rationale: The shot is visual and short, so one brief VO line timed to the can cracking adds voice without crowding the fizz. Words and @soda_can are unchanged.
